close_reason: Fixed in 299aff0: all 9 property selector enums in crate-jmap-chat-types/src/backend.rs now carry #[non_exhaustive]. Canonical propagation to jmap-mail-types tracked at bd:JMAP-nuf5.
description:
SECTION: Public surface immutability

CONTRACT RISK
The 9 property selector enums in crate-jmap-chat-types/src/backend.rs all
lack #[non_exhaustive]:

  ChatProperty            (22 variants)
  MessageProperty         (27 variants)
  SpaceProperty           (12 variants)
  ChatContactProperty     (11 variants)
  ReadPositionProperty    ( 4 variants)
  CustomEmojiProperty     ( 6 variants)
  SpaceInviteProperty     ( 9 variants)
  SpaceBanProperty        ( 7 variants)
  PresenceStatusProperty  ( 7 variants)

Every one carries variants in one-to-one correspondence with a
spec-defined property on its sibling data type. The JMAP Chat draft is
at -00 and the chat-types crate's own AGENTS.md anticipates spec-driven
property additions ("Prefer non-breaking additions (new variants on
#[non_exhaustive] enums, new methods, new accessors)").

Without #[non_exhaustive], adding a variant to ChatProperty (because
draft-01 adds a new Chat property) is a BREAKING CHANGE for every
external caller that matches exhaustively. With #[non_exhaustive], the
addition is non-breaking.

The workspace AGENTS.md attribute-order rule is explicit ("#[non_exhaustive]
-> #[derive(...)] -> #[serde(...)] on every type"). The chat-types
AGENTS.md repeats it. The crate's own Settled Design Constraints table
lists "#[non_exhaustive] -> #[derive(...)] -> #[serde(...)] on every
type" under "Attribute order".

These 9 enums are in violation. They were public-facing before this
diff (so the breaking-change risk pre-dates the review), but commit
fdcfc76 explicitly touched the same lines (added doc comments) and
could have folded the attribute fix into the same commit.

WHAT BREAKS FOR CALLERS
A 0.x.y consumer of jmap-chat-types that pattern-matches on
ChatProperty (a natural usage for a property-projection helper or a
test asserting a property set is complete) gets a compile error on
the day the chat draft adds a new Chat field. With #[non_exhaustive]
they would have to add a `_ =>` arm but the existing arms keep
compiling.

RECOMMENDED RESOLUTION
Add #[non_exhaustive] to all 9 enums. One-line fix per enum, no
behavior change, no wire-format change. Closes the breaking-change
exposure on the entire property-enum surface in one commit.

ORACLE
Workspace AGENTS.md attribute-order rule; chat-types AGENTS.md Settled
Design Constraints; the workspace-level extras-and-forward-compat
section that mandates #[non_exhaustive] on every public result enum.
title: Property selector enums in backend.rs lack #[non_exhaustive]
